investigation_notes.Alert Name: Trend Micro: Malware Detected on Endpoint
investigation_notes.Description: A Trend Micro real-time scan detected a crack/keygen (CRCK_KEYGEN) located in the user's Downloads folder and attempted to quarantine it, but the quarantine failed. The file is classified as a PUA and its location is consistent with a user-downloaded installer rather than system-driven staging. Because remediation did not complete successfully, the risk of execution or further impact is elevated and the alert is prioritized accordingly. No correlated recent events or similar alerts were found for this endpoint or user.
